purpose: Define invariant propagation and narrowing so lower-level contracts may specialize stricter rules but may not weaken higher-level Core or parent invariants.

topics.name: Invariants
topics.purpose: Define invariant propagation and narrowing so lower-level contracts may specialize stricter rules but may not weaken higher-level Core or parent invariants.

semantics.hierarchy_rule: Applicable invariants propagate from Contract Format/Core/parent semantic boundaries to narrower child contracts.
semantics.narrowing_rule: A child may add constraints or narrow allowed behavior.
semantics.weakening_rule: A child may not permit behavior forbidden by an applicable parent/Core invariant.
semantics.conflict_rule: If two applicable authoritative invariants conflict and neither is a valid narrowing, emit an explicit source/semantic conflict gap.
semantics.hard_gate_rule: Hard gates are not overridden by lower-level convenience behavior.

invariants.rule: Machine-significant meaning is explicit structured canonical data and is not reconstructed by hidden heuristics.

hard_gates.condition: child contract weakens an applicable Core invariant
child hard gate overrides parent hard gate to permit forbidden behavior
conflicting invariants are silently resolved by file/path/version order
applicable invariant is ignored because a lower-level contract omits restating it

references.purpose: Conflicting authoritative invariant sources use explicit reconciliation semantics.
Irreconcilable invariant conflicts become explicit gaps.
